episodes.name: A Beating Heart...
episodes.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a ten-week coma. As he begins a painful recovery and learns Harrison has fled to NYC, both father and son are drawn closer to confronting the darkness they’ve tried to escape.

episodes.name: Camera Shy
episodes.description: Dexter embeds himself in New York's ride-share community to track down a serial killer. Meanwhile, Harrison spirals from the guilt of a violent outburst.

episodes.name: Backseat Driver
episodes.description: As Dexter sets his sights on tracking down a serial killer, he must carefully balance Blessing Kamara’s attempts to help get him acclimated to the ride-share driver lifestyle. Meanwhile, Harrison is drawn deeper into the police investigation.
